title: CombatFactPayload
description: The payload of a combat_fact event (AN-46, decision 0345; the key is decision 0321). XP only: not a Mind event. encounter_key is the one combat key of an encounter, enc:<life_id>:<mob entity UUID in lowercase>; a kill and a survive of one encounter pay once. The schema accepts a key whose life part differs from life_id; the sink refuses that pair (AN-47b).
